description: List all Microsoft To Do task lists for the current user
examples: Show me all my to-do lists
What task lists do I have?
List my To Do lists

description: Get a specific Microsoft To Do task list by its ID
examples: Get my 'Work' task list
Show me the details of task list {listId}
Open my grocery list

description: Create a new Microsoft To Do task list
examples: Create a new to-do list called 'Groceries'
Make a new task list named 'Project Alpha'
Add a to-do list for vacation planning

description: Update (rename) an existing Microsoft To Do task list
examples: Rename my 'Groceries' list to 'Shopping'
Change the name of task list {listId}
Update my to-do list name

description: Delete a Microsoft To Do task list
examples: Delete my 'Old Projects' list
Remove task list {listId}
Get rid of my shopping list

description: List all tasks in a specific Microsoft To Do task list
examples: Show me all tasks in my 'Work' list
What tasks are in my grocery list?
List tasks in list {listId}

description: List only incomplete (not completed) tasks in a To Do task list
examples: Show me incomplete tasks in my work list
What tasks haven't I finished yet?
List tasks I still need to do

description: List tasks that are due today in a To Do task list
examples: What tasks are due today?
Show me today's tasks
What do I need to finish today?
notes: Due dates use the dateTimeTimeZone format: { dateTime: '2024-01-15T00:00:00', timeZone: 'UTC' }. Replace {{todayStart}} and {{tomorrowStart}} with the actual ISO date strings for today and tomorrow.

description: List tasks that are past their due date in a To Do task list
examples: What tasks are overdue?
Show me tasks I missed the deadline for
List past-due tasks
notes: Replace {{now}} with the current ISO datetime. Combine with status filter to exclude already-completed tasks.

description: Get a specific task from a Microsoft To Do task list
examples: Show me the details of task {taskId}
Get my 'Buy milk' task
What are the details of that task?

description: Create a new task with just a title in a To Do task list
examples: Add 'Buy milk' to my grocery list
Create a task to call the dentist
Add a reminder to pick up dry cleaning

description: Create a new task with a due date, body content, and importance level in a To Do task list
examples: Create a task 'Submit report' due Friday with high importance
Add a task with notes and a deadline
Create a detailed task in my work list
notes: Due dates use the dateTimeTimeZone format: { dateTime: '2024-01-15T00:00:00', timeZone: 'UTC' }. Importance values: low, normal, high.

description: Update a task's title, body, due date, or importance in a To Do task list
examples: Change the due date of my 'Submit report' task
Update the title of task {taskId}
Set importance to high for that task
notes: Include only the fields you want to update. Due dates use the dateTimeTimeZone format: { dateTime: '2024-01-15T00:00:00', timeZone: 'UTC' }. Importance values: low, normal, high.

description: Mark a task as completed in a To Do task list
examples: Mark 'Buy milk' as done
Complete the task {taskId}
I finished the 'Submit report' task
notes: The completedDateTime must include a timeZone object when completing a task. Set dateTime to the current ISO timestamp.

description: Reopen a completed task by setting its status back to notStarted
examples: Reopen the 'Buy milk' task
Mark that task as not done
Un-complete task {taskId}

description: Delete a task from a Microsoft To Do task list
examples: Delete the 'Buy milk' task
Remove task {taskId} from my list
Get rid of that task

description: List all checklist items (subtasks) on a To Do task
examples: Show me the checklist items on task {taskId}
What subtasks does this task have?
List the checklist for my 'Pack for trip' task

description: Create a new checklist item (subtask) on a To Do task
examples: Add a checklist item 'Pack shoes' to my packing task
Create a subtask under task {taskId}
Add a step to my task

description: Update a checklist item on a To Do task (toggle checked/unchecked or rename)
examples: Check off 'Pack shoes' from the checklist
Mark checklist item as done
Uncheck the first checklist item
notes: Set isChecked to true to mark complete, false to uncheck. Include only the fields you want to update.

description: Delete a checklist item from a To Do task
examples: Remove 'Pack shoes' from the checklist
Delete checklist item {checklistItemId}
Remove that subtask
